content:
maria: Hey sec team — quick security/privacy review request for PR #7241. This touches KMS proxy routing and adds an optional egress path for private VPCs in onprem installs. Main asks: confirm no secret leakage, token lifetime implications, and whether we need an HSM fallback. /cc @zach @lee :eyes:

zach: Looking now. Can you paste the minimal diff or list of changed files? link to PR? :mag:

maria: PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/platform/pull/7241
Changed: `services/kms-proxy/*`, `deploy/onprem/vpc-egress.yaml`, small authz change in `authn/middleware.go`
Quick diff snippet:
```diff
- proxy.targets = ["kms.internal"]
+ proxy.targets = ["kms.internal", "kms-proxy.vpc"]
```

lee: Quick questions: 1) Does this add any new env vars with secrets? 2) Are we sending any tokens across egress path in plaintext?

maria: 1) No new plaintext env secrets. We pass encrypted service tokens to the proxy (same as current flow). 2) The egress path sends TLS to customer KMS endpoints. We do preserve the existing service token header `X-Redwood-Token` — it's a short-lived token generated from our control plane.

sec-bot: Automated scan results for PR #7241:
- Secret scan: no new hard-coded secrets found :white_check_mark:
- Dependency scan: no new risky deps :white_check_mark:
- Static analysis: flagged potential nil-check in authn/middleware.go (LOW) :warning:
Link: https://ci.redwood/scans/7241

zach: Can you paste the code around the nil-check? low severity but want to be sure it isn't auth bypass.

maria: snippet:
```go
// authn/middleware.go
if token == nil {
  // previously we returned 401 here
  // changed to allow fallback for onprem proxy
  token = getFallbackToken()
}
```
I added fallback to support older onprem control planes. Fallback token is scoped to only call KMS metadata endpoints, not data plane encryption ops.

lee: Fallback tokens are always sensitive. Need explicit justification in PR and a tight TTL. What's TTL?

maria: TTL is 60s. We also rotate the fallback token on each process restart. Documented in PR description.

sam: What's the intended rollout window? Can we canary to a single onprem customer first? Also want a rollback runbook if token misuse detected.

maria: Plan: deploy to staging today, canary to tenant-42 tomorrow for 2 hours, then broader. Rollback: revert deploy via console (route back to kms.internal) + revoke all fallback tokens via control plane endpoint `/admin/revoke-fallback`. Runbook in PR.

zach: Two asks before I can LGTM:
1) Add explicit unit test for fallback path ensuring fallback token scope is limited.
2) Add a short note in CHANGELOG / security rationale explaining why fallback is required and mitigations (TTL, restart rotation, scope).

maria: Will add both. Also added a smoke e2e command to validate onprem egress locally:
```bash
# run local proxy against staging KMS endpoint
KMS_ENDPOINT=https://kms-staging.example.com ./bin/kms-proxy --config deploy/onprem/vpc-egress.yaml --dry-run
# curl the metadata endpoint
curl -H "X-Redwood-Token: $FALLBACK_TOKEN" https://localhost:8443/metadata
```

sec-bot: SAST followup: nil-check flagged in `authn/middleware.go` — recommended fix: explicitly check and log then return 401 unless fallback explicitly enabled via config flag `ALLOW_FALLBACK=true` set in onprem builds. See rules-15.

lee: I agree with sec-bot. Add a config gating flag and require it to be off by default. And log an audit event when fallback is used.

maria: Ok will add `ALLOW_FALLBACK` default false and an audit log line. Also will add a small e2e test that toggles the flag.

zach: Once those are in, I can review the tests and give LGTM. Also please add a note to the private deploy runbook about revoking fallback tokens post-merge.

sam: For timing: if we can get tests and gating flag today, we can slot merge tomorrow morning during the low-traffic window (02:00 - 04:00 UTC). I'll reserve the window. :calendar:

maria: Thanks all — pushing updates now. Will ping when ready for final review. :thumbsup:

zach: :rocket:

lee: Thanks, appreciate the quick follow-up.

maria: Update posted — added gating flag, audit log, unit + e2e tests, and changelog blurb. pinging @zach for final review. 5601237925

zach: Reviewing now. If green, I'll approve and coordinate merge tomorrow morning. :white_check_mark:
